name: Planet 13 Holdings Inc.
summary: Planet 13 Holdings Inc., headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, operates as an integrated cannabis enterprise primarily within the Nevada market in the United States. The company manages the entire lifecycle of cannabis products, from cultivation and manufacturing to distribution and sales, catering to both medicinal and recreational consumers. Beyond its core cannabis operations, which include licensed dispensaries, Planet 13 diversifies its business. It also runs a non-cannabis retail store, an event space, and a suite of hospitality ventures: the Trece Eatery + Spirits, a coffee shop, and a pizzeria. Furthermore, Planet 13 offers various client services such as consultation, educational programs, and convenience solutions. The company develops and owns a wide array of cannabis products, encompassing chocolates, gummies, sparkling beverages, vapes, concentrates, and flowers, sold under proprietary brand names like TRENDI, Leaf & Vine, Dreamland, HaHa, and Medizin.
